components.name: Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells
components.reasoning: The core photovoltaic element that converts sunlight into electricity, universally present and always procured as individual cells or cell strings prior to module assembly.

components.name: Tempered Glass Cover
components.reasoning: Industry-standard protective front layer offering durability, weather resistance, and optical transparency; almost all modules use a separate tempered glass sheet.

components.name: Aluminum Frame
components.reasoning: Structural support providing mechanical rigidity and mounting interfaces, typically procured as a complete frame from suppliers.

components.name: Encapsulation Material (Ethylene Vinyl Acetate - EVA)
components.reasoning: Specialized polymer sheet used to bind and protect solar cells inside the module, usually supplied as a distinct manufactured raw film used in lamination.

components.name: Backsheet
components.reasoning: Protective rear layer providing electrical insulation and environmental protection, procured as a separate component; some premium modules use glass-glass assembly instead.

components.name: Junction Box
components.reasoning: Encases bypass diodes and provides the electrical connection interface for the module; a manufactured part with a distinct supply chain.

components.name: Bypass Diode Assembly
components.reasoning: Electronic subassembly housed within the junction box to prevent power loss from shaded cells; often standard but integrated into the junction box making it sometimes inseparable.

components.name: Cable and Connectors
components.reasoning: Pre-assembled electrical cables with MC4 or compatible connectors provide the external electrical connectivity; usually procured as assemblies but sometimes integrated into the junction box wiring.

Solar Cell.name: Silicon
Solar Cell.reasoning: Silicon is the fundamental semiconductor material converting sunlight to electricity, universally essential in solar cells with no practical substitutes.

Solar Cell.name: Phosphorus
Solar Cell.reasoning: Phosphorus is commonly used as an N-type dopant in silicon solar cells to create the PN junction; standard choice, though minor alternatives exist.

Solar Cell.name: Boron
Solar Cell.reasoning: Boron serves as a P-type dopant for silicon in the PN junction of solar cells, widely used but gallium can be an alternative.

Solar Cell.name: Silver
Solar Cell.reasoning: Silver is the standard front contact metallization material in solar cells due to its excellent conductivity, though copper alternatives are emerging.

Solar Cell.name: Aluminum
Solar Cell.reasoning: Aluminum is typically used for the back contact and frame of solar cells, universally essential for electrical and mechanical functions.
